material_findings.claim: Completed07 should replace receiving06 in the next integrated candidate
material_findings.tier: inferred artistic judgment from confirmed pixels
material_findings.finding: Reject the whole replacement. At identical neutral/workshop cameras receiving06 has a readable broad warm orange iris; completed07 has a small pale orange point within a mostly black seat. Advanced whole-bird awakening is substantially weaker and less source-aligned. The locked composite, July head, Advanced-era image and First Choice frames preserve an orange focal eye at whole scale. A reduction from a flat target-like iris is useful, but this reduction goes too far.
material_findings.consequence: Adoption trades the central era cue for local realism, violating the explicit no-sacrifice criterion.
material_findings.next_test: Keep receiving06 integrated; test a reversible cavity variant with a broader warm orange luminous area/gradient, at these same full-bird cameras in native and browser. Do not resolve solely by raising the tiny point brightness.

material_findings.claim: Cavity construction improves the local physical optic reading
material_findings.finding: Completed07 head close-ups show a dark inner well, multiple depth rims and a smaller light behind the outer metal collar, improving depth over the flat concentric orange target in receiving06. Maker/Mechanic also gain visible internal optical structure over a blank dark hole. The heavy smooth circular collar remains more regular and less integrated into layered cheek hardware than the pinned head.
material_findings.consequence: A local improvement can be mistaken for whole-character gain.
material_findings.next_test: Retain cavity/depth idea separately, pair it with the repaired Advanced luminous area and a source-grounded cheek framing comparison.

material_findings.claim: Unequal nonemissive retainers establish source-faithful hardware realism
material_findings.tier: unknown artistic sufficiency; confirmed GLB nonemission for new metal materials
material_findings.finding: Dark metal rims are visible and GLB metal/bronze/glass/cavity materials are nonemissive. Unequal retainers do not read clearly enough in the reviewed head/full-bird pixels to justify a strong source-faithful asymmetry claim; they mostly read as circular dark nested rims. Source cheek/crown hardware has visibly interrupted, varied layered construction.
material_findings.consequence: Geometric asymmetry or material flags may be reported as an artistic improvement that is not perceptible.
material_findings.next_test: Use the same head camera with source beside candidate; require visible interruptions/asymmetry without brightening metal rings.

material_findings.claim: Maker and Mechanic remain dark and nonawakened
material_findings.tier: confirmed visible pixels and independently parsed static GLB defaults
material_findings.finding: All reviewed native/full/detail/angle and supplied browser views retain dark Maker/Mechanic optics. Parsed new GLB optic materials have default zero emissiveFactor and no emissive-strength extension; Advanced core alone has [1,1,1] with strength5. This confirms static GLB behavior and visible supplied results, not a fresh native shader audit.
material_findings.consequence: Era rules would be violated by lit early optics.
material_findings.next_test: Preserve this material separation during any repaired Advanced variant.

material_findings.claim: Optic07 improves threatening avian identity and full-source likeness
material_findings.finding: Both versions retain a hooked upper bill, swept crown and avian legs, so the optic pass does not create a new anteater reading. It also does not materially improve bird identity. Compared with locked canon/July head, the bill is a large smooth slab, cheek opening is a broad sparse void with thin jaw struts, neck is a narrow vertical stack, shoulder/breast plates are large uniform petal forms, and feet/claws read smoother and more repetitive than the source articulated hardware. Rear views expose a broad smooth back with limited overlapping shielding. These are retained receiving06 gaps, not regressions caused by optic07. Source-camera estimation and fixed approved pose limit dimensional conclusions; no numerical proportion or posture correction is proposed.
material_findings.consequence: An optic success could be used to prematurely certify the whole exterior.
material_findings.next_test: Keep head/neck/cheek and regional construction work as separate bounded visual tasks, with whole-source comparisons and fixed pose.

material_findings.claim: Native and browser artistic appearance are equivalent
material_findings.finding: Supplied WebGL screenshots have a flatter, noisier/darker metal read than the clean native illustrated view, and Advanced light is even less legible at full-bird scale. Same semantic material values do not establish pixel equivalence. All era screenshots depict a loaded bird, but review of supplied screenshots is not independent live execution.
material_findings.consequence: Native-only approval could misrepresent browser appearance.
material_findings.next_test: After an optic repair, repeat matched native/browser whole/head images under declared lighting/tone mapping and inspect the actual WebGL result.
